basic_info.description: Welcome home to this inviting 1 bed, 2 bath condominium in the heart of Noe Valley, perched above vibrant 24th Street. Located in an elevator building, this light-filled unit offers a seamless blend of comfort and style. The open-concept living area features a cozy corner fireplace and a well-appointed kitchen with stainless steel appliances, ample cabinetry, and a large counter with bar seating perfect for entertaining. The spacious bedroom offers a quiet retreat, complemented by an ensuite bath with marble counters, dual sinks, and a jetted tub. A second full bath features a stall shower, elegant built-in cabinetry, and a washer/dryer closet for added convenience. Take in the neighborhood's charm from your private balcony, or enjoy the shared garden and community room. Deeded storage and serene neighborhood views add to the home's everyday appeal. Ideally situated just steps from Noe Valley's renowned cafes, boutiques, restaurants, and Whole Foods, this unit offers an exceptional city lifestyle whether as a primary residence or second home. Age Limitation: one occupant of the condo must be 62 years old. However, no age limitation to purchase or own (if separate from occupancy).
